# Copilot instructions — Accessible Tantra website

**Read [`/agent.md`](../agent.md) first — it is the complete, authoritative guide for this
repo. Follow it over your own assumptions.**

This is the website of **Accessible Tantra** (a disability-access non‑profit): React 18 + Vite 5,
React Router 7 (**HashRouter**), plain CSS with design tokens. No TypeScript, no CSS framework,
no external fonts. Deployed to GitHub Pages at `accesstantra.com` on every push to `main`
(via `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`). Node 20.x.

## Build / test / lint

```bash
npm install        # first time
npm run dev        # local dev server with hot reload (http://localhost:5173)
npm run build      # production build into dist/ — RUN THIS BEFORE COMMITTING
npm run preview    # serve the built dist/ to sanity-check the production build
```

There are **no tests and no linter** configured. "Passing" = `npm run build` completes with no
errors and the page looks/behaves correctly. There is no single-test command because there are
no tests.

## Architecture (the big picture)

`index.html` → `src/main.jsx` (wraps `<App/>` in `<HashRouter>`) → `src/App.jsx` (all routes,
under `Layout.jsx`). The app is **data-driven**: `App.jsx` maps a URL param to a data object and
renders the generic `src/components/ContentPage.jsx`. The **Programs** nav dropdown
(`Header.jsx`) builds itself from `src/data/initiatives.js`. So adding an initiative/course/event
is a *data edit* — it auto-updates the nav, routes, listing pages, and `/programs/<id>` with no
new components. The `ContentPage` page-object shape and per-file data reference are documented in
`agent.md` §6–§7.

## Critical rules (full details and step-by-step recipes are in `agent.md`)

1. **Accessibility is required** (semantic HTML, labels, focus, WCAG-AA contrast) — it's the org's mission.
2. **No inline styles.** Use the CSS variables/tokens and utility classes in `src/index.css` and the per-component `.css` files.
3. **One `<h1>` per page** (the header title is the `<h1>` on Home only).
4. **Never use `href="#..."`** — HashRouter treats it as a route and breaks the page. Use a `<button>` + `element.focus()`. Don't switch to BrowserRouter.
5. **Keep `vite.config.js` `base: '/'` and `public/CNAME` (`accesstantra.com`).**
6. **Most content lives in `src/data/`** (`initiatives.js`, `courses.js`, `pastEvents.js`, `site.js`). Adding/removing an item there auto-updates the nav, routes, and listings. Prefer data edits over new code. Import shared constants from `site.js` rather than hardcoding.
7. **Prefer embedded Google Forms** (`form: { type: 'embed', src: '…viewform?embedded=true' }`); native forms break if the form collects a *verified* email.
8. **Hindi text needs `lang="hi"`.**
9. **Don't edit `dist/`** — it's generated by `npm run build`. Edit `src/`.
10. **Don't remove `{ preventScroll: true }`** in `Layout.jsx` — without it the Home header scrolls off and the page renders blank.
11. **Brand name is always "Accessible Tantra"** (not "Access Tantra").
12. Run `npm run build` (must pass) before committing. Commit/push to `main` as the **`accesstantra`** git identity (email `accesstantra@gmail.com`); other accounts lack push access. Pushing triggers the deploy.

When unsure how to make a change, find the matching recipe in `agent.md` §8.
